description: Fork of exp273 (dual-stream E=64 -> 1.6807 @ b=8/8K) with device_batch_size 8 -> 32 (4x). Tests the bigger-batch lever (per memory: 'scaling device_batch_size to memory ceiling is the dominant lever') on the dual-stream architecture. exp267 (different hybrid recipe) saw -0.015 bpb going b=8 -> b=32 at 8K steps. If dual-stream sees similar magnitude, exp289 would land near 1.665. Same recipe as exp273 otherwise: d_v=32, v_lut multi-alt NAP=8 tph=256, out_proj per-layer [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024], residual_lut soft NAP=6 tph=1024, no ffn_lut, no partition_sets.
